correctness.rationale: For a single conductance tau at edge (0,1), the sharp l²–energy point-evaluation constant is sup_{j,lambda}2sqrt(lambda)<delta_j,(L_tau+lambda)^-1 delta_j>. The free lattice Green kernel r^{|i-j|+1}/(1-r²), lambda=(1-r)²/r, and rank-one resolvent perturbation yield G_tau,j=r/(1-r²) -(tau-1)r^{2+2k(j)}/[(1+r)(1+(2tau-1)r)]. For 0<tau<1 maximum lies exactly at j=0,1; derivative of K_tau(r)=2sqrt(r)(1+(tau-1)r)/[1+(2tau-1)r] has sign of polynomial 1+(tau-2)r+(tau-1)(2tau-1)r² and one root r_tau∈(0,1). Rank-one recurrence recovers both reflected extremizers with the displayed geometric tails. For tau>=1 free Green upper bound=1 and translating free nearly extremal geometric profiles proves sharpness but nonattainment. Implicit differentiation of root identifies unique minimum localization r at tau=(4-sqrt2)/7, r=4sqrt2-5. Independently computed six 1001-site geometric energy ratios exactly approaching sharp formula; edge and monotonicity bounds reviewed analytically.
residual_risks: τ=0 excluded; no multi-bond or d>=2 extension. Truncations are numerical checks, sharp infinite lattice constant follows resolvent proof.
